title: Bound the deferred chart-905 repair for owned 1502
body:
## Result

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** This tests one fixed repair after fusing owned role 1502's rank-one MOVEs 33140 and 33142 into a rank-two descent from chart 541 to 117 and omitting ADD33141. The repair may use the complete edited chart-905 bank before the observer's first outward read, ADD43317. The bank includes role 152 delivered by paid MOVE43315 and edited observer 1489.

The exact public input with coordinate 2 set to −4 and all others zero annihilates both edited rows. The historical donor is 1, the old observer is 4, and the old ADD leaves role 152 at −2. An independent literal normalized forward replay verifies both prefixes, both lower reads, the active bank, ownership and the old outward response. The one case exhausted. Different routes, earlier corrections and changed downstream interfaces remain open.

The hypothetical signed paid delta is −34 rank-one and +17 rank-two with no productive delta. Directed gross lies in [0.08584222521755123, 0.08584222521755124] raw before repairs. One extra rank-one child per copy would cost 17 raw across the signed caller. The fixed route realizes no saving.

## Exact source and replay

Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57, comparator #7481 at 89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b, and signed #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. This refines the P104 native paid-repair scope. The two #7257 CI prerequisites are separate ancestor commits.

From a clean POSIX checkout using CPython 3.12 and its standard library, run

    python3.12 -I -B research/p104-owned1502-deferred-fusion-bound/replay.py

Expected PASS_OWNED1502_DEFERRED_FUSION_BOUND. Both scientific runners exited zero within their 30-second caps. Direct and registered replay, exact committed bytes and modes, source history, official read-only Git-free export replay, and all 27 local onboarding tests passed on the submitted tree 6e9fd6556b20c10707e468cfa44e0206d6532287. Hosted verification is separate.

## Credit and next question

#7481, #7480 and #7334 supply the native lineage, #7113 the signed caller, #7003 and #7494 the timing precedent, #7482 the reverse covectors and #7298 the directed tariff. #7491 checks terminal banks, #7492 a distinct owned fusion, and #7495 and #7500 different deferred repairs. #7508 supplies public copies of exact inputs. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted proof, implementation, independent replay and packaging.

Reopen this route with a named operation or earlier encoding that transports the missing direction. Check the signed sender, receiver and first outward deadline before repricing the edit.
